title: Hologram swap in Spain this May?

posts.topic_title: Hologram swap in Spain this May?
posts.author: MichaelH
posts.post_subject: Hologram swap in Spain this May?
posts.content_md:
Wifey and I are travelling to Spain this May and are meeting up with Arturo in Madrid to drink some beers and swap tales and holograms.

Andres suggested that I see if anyone else would like to join in to make it a mini-PCG Gathering or something similar. I can't commit significant portions of our vacation to holography but it would be cool to be able to get together with several of you across the pond.

We'll be starting out in Madrid and ending in Barcelona. Anyone interested in coming out to talk holography for a while?
